Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an 
 (1/4) annually bases as indicated by M3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Issy, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Stop the unit
Isolate the air fan mechanical & 
 electrical
To lose the pressure isolate the 
 subscriber valves for 32 kg reduction station steam
Open the drain valves (continues 
 & emergency)
Tools 
and Equipment
Work shop kit (spanners & wrenches)
Screw drivers & Gear pullers ... 
 etc
General purpose grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Spanner & Wrenches
Allen keys
Graphite metal jacket
Work to be 
carried out
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective units
Remove insulation
Check external body and piping 
 joint
Check the valves (gland - seat - 
 disk - bolts - screw) for safety valves, drain & levels
Check the flanges, setting & 
 bolts
Check the drain piping
Check the leakage
Check the drum main holes
Check the manuel valves (32 kg steam 
 - auxiliary)
Check the condition (open & close)
Check the external isolating cover
Check the vents & valves
Assemble the element
Adjust
Check after repairing
Restore all valves to the operation normal position
Clean the area after repairing
